InsightQuestionBook-〈topic〉/

Question Book folder

proposals/
    runs/
      jNN_question-vN_〈slug〉/
      • 3.1src/

        shared question or preparation code, pinned with its version

      • 3.2runs/

        operations at this scope; execution evidence belongs to Board Tasks

      • 3.3tNN_〈L〉NN_〈question〉/

        a Task: one question at one level (D, I, K, W or X)

        • 3.3.1scripts/

          the question script or prep step implementation

          • 3.3.1.1〈script〉.py

            the declared entry script; a prep step exposes run(ctx)

        • 3.3.2runs/

          operations at this scope; execution evidence belongs to Board Tasks

        • 3.3.3question.md

          the question, its level and the method an answer uses

      • 3.4jNN_〈job〉.md

        the Job's face: its versions, goal and Tasks in order

      • 3.5release.yaml

        the questions this version holds, kept ones pointing to the Task that first asked them

      • 3.6partitions.md

        the segments every answer is cut by

      • 3.7thresholds.yaml

        predeclared floors, thresholds and seeds

                    Why these groups and types

                    Each Job is a question-set version, without a repeated version group; Tasks group by DIKWX.

                    A type names a responsibility from the contract; the files carry no job-type or task-type field.

                    The live Jobs page lists only local Tasks, so it misses questions release.yaml keeps from an earlier version; this structure resolves every member.
